releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.4.4

- Uses the current athlete-wide Intervals.icu cycling eFTP rather than an activity-specific historical value.
- Keeps Intervals.icu cycling FTP synchronized to that eFTP and refreshes future percentage-based workouts whose names contain TT Pace.
- Adds an optional Strava profile connection for synchronizing the same FTP after a one-time approval.
- Lets Bike Coach request core temperature and other Intervals.icu activity streams without exporting GPS/location streams.
- Establishes TT Pace as the standard name marker for actual time-trial pacing files; warm-ups and between-race re-warms remain separate.
